signature: White-ribbed concrete halls lit from walls, ceilings and floor, with stretches of total dark; engine halls behind laminated glass and reinforced doors; the lab-coated dead with makeshift spears; Enric's camp in the control room under a radar every terminal shares; and, at the end, an emptied engine room whose glowing doorframe opens on a starfield and a still blue sphere.

exits.to_label: Unnamed, undocumented level (the void of space beyond the doorframe)
exits.label: Stepped through the glowing doorframe into the night beyond
exits.source_quote: a doorframe, leading to what appears to be the empty void of space
exits.hint: The room at the end of the halls has no engines left in it. Something at its back glows.

entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. No living entity; dead humans in lab coats and piled Hound corpses only. Enric (the only known resident) is not spawned: his camp is shown, he is out.
notes: SOURCE: futuristic hallways of white or gray concrete with white steel beams bearing arabesque-like symbols; large lights on walls, ceilings or ground; occasional pitch-black areas; engine noise from large rooms behind reinforced metal doors with a thick glass wall section; machines from laptop size to unmeasurable, some producing steel rods; rare rooms of exploded machines with glass shattered but not broken; labs, dormitories, kitchens, control rooms, storage (food, water, equipment), mostly empty; desiccated lab-coated corpses with makeshift knives and spears, no firearms; dried blood; Hound corpses piled in a cremation room; no Almond Water; Avalon 2.4 terminals with unreadable files; identical scanner displays on every terminal; Enric's camp in a large control room; the Level 10 door slammed shut and never reopened; the doorframe room with no engines, a glowing frame, a night sky and a still blue sphere, behind an intact reinforced door. ADAPTATION: the authored layout and dimensions (page: at least 6,080 km2, no map); the doorframe room 'two hours from camp' sits at the end of a 165 m spine; the cross gallery ends at sealed doors to imply the halls continue; the flywheel, drum and rod press forms; the scanner's object set and timings; the exposure counter gives captions only (irradiation is only 'possible' on the page); Enric's laptop, map and survey sheet are framing devices for paraphrased page text. L015>L010#1 (door back, closed since) is an interactable that never opens. Not built: Enric as an NPC, the radar GIF itself (footnote not captured).
